theme.en: AI Hardware Faces Supply and Financing Constraints
theme.zh: AI硬件面临供货与资金约束

dek.en: GPU customer restrictions, scarce DRAM and a concentrated optical-materials supply chain complicate AI infrastructure expansion. Kioxia and Nvidia explore SSD-backed memory capacity while HPE stresses guarantees and prepayments for neocloud sales.
dek.zh: GPU客户限制、DRAM紧缺及高度集中的光互连材料供应链，让AI基础设施扩张面临更多约束。铠侠与Nvidia探索以SSD扩展有效内存容量，HPE则强调向新兴AI云服务商销售设备需要担保和预付款。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: HPE requires guarantees and prepayments for neocloud sales
title.zh: HPE要求新兴AI云客户提供担保和预付款

summary.en: HPE CEO Antonio Neri says investing in neocloud companies is not a suitable use of HPE's capital and that sales to them require guarantees and prepayments, Wccftech reports. He instead emphasizes enterprise and sovereign computing. That stance makes customers' financing capacity an explicit condition of supplying AI infrastructure, even as demand for GPUs remains strong.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，HPE首席执行官Antonio Neri表示，投资新兴AI云服务商并非HPE资本的合适用途，向这些企业销售设备需要担保和预付款。他更强调企业计算与主权计算市场。这一立场将客户的融资能力明确纳入AI基础设施供货条件，即使GPU需求依然强劲。

title.en: AMD introduces RT-MLAS to reduce ray-tracing memory and rebuild costs
title.zh: AMD推出RT-MLAS，降低光线追踪内存占用与重建开销

summary.en: AMD has introduced Ray Tracing Multi-Level Acceleration Structures through GPUOpen, with a Vulkan extension available for Radeon RX 9000 GPUs and DirectX 12 support planned. Wccftech reports up to 92% lower BVH memory use and up to 3.7× faster rebuilds on a Radeon RX 9070. These results target the cost of representing large, changing scenes; the supplied excerpt does not describe the benchmark workloads behind those headline gains.
summary.zh: AMD通过GPUOpen推出Ray Tracing Multi-Level Acceleration Structures，已为Radeon RX 9000系列GPU提供Vulkan扩展，并计划支持DirectX 12。Wccftech报道称，在Radeon RX 9070上，BVH内存占用最多降低92%，重建速度最高提升至3.7倍。这些结果针对大型动态场景的表示开销，但所提供片段未说明上述峰值收益对应的基准负载。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Trump is scheduled to attend TSMC's Arizona groundbreaking on December 4
title.zh: 特朗普据报将于12月4日出席台积电亚利桑那奠基仪式

summary.en: Asia Economy reports that Trump will attend a TSMC Arizona groundbreaking on December 4. The planned appearance puts the company's U.S. manufacturing expansion back in the policy spotlight. A groundbreaking marks a construction milestone; the supplied item gives no production-start date, process node or added wafer capacity.
summary.zh: 据《亚洲经济》报道，特朗普将于12月4日出席台积电亚利桑那项目的奠基仪式。这一行程使台积电在美国的制造扩张再次成为政策焦点。奠基属于建设节点，所提供条目未说明投产时间、制程或新增晶圆产能。

title.en: Samsung reportedly targets fab robots for deployment by 2028
title.zh: 三星据报计划到2028年在晶圆厂部署机器人

summary.en: Samsung has reportedly formed a robotics team and aims to deploy unmanned vehicles, autonomous robots and robotic arms in chip factories by 2028, according to Wccftech's account of ETNews reporting. The roadmap covers equipment maintenance and production-line work. It could extend automation into more fab operations, but the supplied report gives no deployment scale or measured productivity improvements.
summary.zh: Wccftech援引ETNews报道称，三星已组建机器人团队，计划到2028年在芯片工厂部署无人车辆、自主移动机器人与机械臂。路线图涉及设备维护及产线作业。这可能将自动化扩展至更多晶圆厂环节，但所提供报道未给出部署规模或生产效率提升的实测数据。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Kioxia and Nvidia explore SSDs to expand effective HBM capacity
title.zh: 铠侠与Nvidia探索以SSD扩展HBM有效容量

summary.en: Kioxia and Nvidia are collaborating on using SSDs to expand effective high-bandwidth memory capacity, TechPowerUp reports. The effort targets the capacity constraint in AI systems by bringing storage into the memory hierarchy. The supplied item does not quantify latency, bandwidth or application performance, so it does not establish that SSDs can substitute for HBM at equivalent speed.
summary.zh: 据TechPowerUp报道，铠侠与Nvidia正合作探索利用SSD扩展高带宽内存的有效容量。该方向通过将存储设备纳入内存层次，缓解AI系统的容量约束。所提供条目未量化时延、带宽或应用性能，因此尚不能据此认定SSD可以同等速度替代HBM。

title.en: Electronics makers organize DRAM sourcing teams as shortages strain cash
title.zh: DRAM紧缺挤压现金，电子制造商组建专门采购团队

summary.en: Electronics manufacturers are setting up dedicated teams to secure DRAM through online listings, brokers and gray-market channels, Tom's Hardware reports. Some companies have taken out loans so they can buy chips as soon as supplies appear. The scramble links component availability directly to working-capital needs and production continuity, beyond the effect of higher memory prices alone.
summary.zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，电子制造商正组建专门团队，通过线上货源、经纪商和灰色市场渠道争取DRAM供应。部分企业甚至借款，以便在芯片现货出现时立即采购。这场争夺使元器件可得性直接关联到营运资金需求和生产连续性，影响已超出存储涨价本身。

title.en: Jeff Pu cuts 2027 DRAM price forecasts and models a 2028 halving
title.zh: Jeff Pu下调2027年DRAM价格预测，并设想2028年价格减半

summary.en: GF Securities analyst Jeff Pu has lowered his DRAM contract-price growth forecasts for all four quarters of 2027 to 6%, 3%, 0% and 0% sequentially, according to Wccftech. His newly introduced 2028 base case envisages prices halving. This is an analyst scenario rather than an observed price decline, but it shifts attention from immediate shortages to the durability of memory suppliers' pricing power.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，广发证券分析师Jeff Pu下调了2027年全部4个季度的DRAM合约价涨幅预测，最新环比增幅依次为6%、3%、0%和0%。他首次提出的2028年基准情景设想价格减半。这属于分析师预测情景，而非已经发生的价格下跌，但它将关注点从眼前短缺延伸至存储厂商定价能力能维持多久。

title.en: Equipment, Materials & Design Tools
title.zh: 设备、材料与设计工具

title.en: Siemens plans Breker and Lauterbach acquisitions to expand development tools
title.zh: 西门子拟收购Breker与Lauterbach，扩展开发工具布局

summary.en: Siemens plans to acquire Breker and Lauterbach to broaden its SoC verification and software-debugging capabilities, EE Times reports. The deals would bring more of the hardware and software development workflow into its tool portfolio. An analyst cited in the report expects integration benefits to take time; these are planned transactions rather than completed integrations.
summary.zh: 据EE Times报道，西门子计划收购Breker与Lauterbach，扩展SoC验证与软件调试能力。两笔交易将使其工具组合覆盖更多软硬件开发流程。报道援引的分析师认为，整合收益需要时间才能体现；目前进展仍是拟议交易，并非已经完成工具整合。

title.en: AI optical demand puts pressure on the concentrated InP supply chain
title.zh: AI光互连需求加压高度集中的InP供应链

summary.en: Tom's Hardware examines pressure on the indium phosphide supply chain as AI infrastructure shifts toward optical interconnects. InP supports lasers, transceivers and co-packaged optics, making material availability relevant across several interconnect technologies. The report frames a concentrated materials supply as a constraint on optical expansion, although the supplied excerpt gives no quantified capacity shortfall.
summary.zh: Tom's Hardware分析了AI基础设施转向光互连时，磷化铟供应链承受的压力。InP用于激光器、光收发器及共封装光学，其供给关系到多种互连技术。报道将材料供应的高度集中视为光互连扩张的约束，但所提供片段未量化产能缺口。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Nvidia GPU buyers reportedly must exclude Chinese renters
title.zh: Nvidia GPU买家据报被要求排除中国租用方

summary.en: Nvidia chip buyers are being told to rule out Chinese renters as a condition of purchasing GPUs, CNBC reports, citing sources. Such a condition would connect hardware procurement to who can rent the resulting compute capacity. The supplied item does not specify its legal basis or customer scope, so it should be treated as a reported purchasing restriction rather than a fully documented new regulation.
summary.zh: CNBC援引消息人士报道称，Nvidia芯片买家被告知，购买GPU需要排除中国租用方。这类条件将硬件采购与后续算力可以租给谁直接联系起来。所提供条目未说明法律依据或客户适用范围，因此应将其视为报道中的采购限制，而非细则已经明确的新法规。

title.en: Dutch minister says the Netherlands will seek non-enforcement of the MATCH Act
title.zh: 荷兰部长称将请求美国不执行MATCH Act

summary.en: The Netherlands will ask Washington not to enforce the MATCH Act, a minister says, according to Reuters. The request is relevant to the export-control environment facing Dutch chipmaking-equipment suppliers, including ASML. It signals a planned diplomatic intervention, while the supplied item reports no U.S. concession or change to licensing requirements.
summary.zh: 据路透社报道，荷兰一名部长表示，荷兰将请求华盛顿不执行MATCH Act。这一请求关系到ASML等荷兰芯片制造设备供应商面临的出口管制环境。它表明荷兰计划展开外交交涉，但所提供条目未报道美国作出让步或许可要求发生变化。

theme.en: Memory and Parameter Reuse Reshape Efficient Inference
theme.zh: 内存与参数复用重塑高效推理

dek.en: Five AI preprints examine sparse-cache sharing, looped architectures, lookup tables and compression, alongside a communications study on selective adaptation. The selection focuses on what changes compute and memory demands, distinguishing architectural claims from measured deployment gains.
dek.zh: 5篇AI预印本讨论稀疏缓存共享、循环架构、查找表和压缩，另有1篇通信研究考察选择性适配。选文关注计算与内存需求如何变化，并区分架构层面的主张与实际部署收益。

title.en: Hardware-Relevant AI Research
title.zh: 面向硬件效率的AI研究

title.en: DFly2 shares a sparse target's KV cache and position selection
title.zh: DFly2共享稀疏目标模型的KV缓存与位置选择结果

papers.authors: Hong Liu, Rui Cen, Junhan Shi, et al.

summary.en: DFly2 uses a block-parallel draft model that shares a sparse target model's KV cache and attention-position selection, avoiding a separate draft cache and redundant selection work. The authors report that a selection made one step earlier still covers close to 90% of positions selected by later tokens on DS-V4.1-Flash. This targets memory traffic, prefill overhead and serving concurrency in long-context speculative decoding. The supplied abstract is truncated before end-to-end performance results, so the overlap figure should not be read as a measured speedup.
summary.zh: DFly2采用块并行草稿模型，共享稀疏目标模型的KV缓存与注意力位置选择结果，从而避免独立草稿缓存及重复的位置筛选。作者报告，在DS-V4.1-Flash上，提前一步生成的选择结果仍能覆盖后续token所选位置的近90%。该方法针对长上下文推测解码的内存流量、预填充开销和服务并发约束。所提供摘要在端到端性能结果之前截断，因此这一覆盖率不能解读为实测加速比。

title.en: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer reuses KV memory across depth and loops
title.zh: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer跨深度与循环复用KV记忆

papers.authors: Lianghui Zhu, Shijie Wang, Xinggang Wang, et al.

summary.en: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer changes what passes between repeated Transformer loops by using keys and values as selectively reusable memory. Its U-shaped variant separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. The authors report outperforming OLMo3 after 400B-token pretraining across 700M- and 1.5B-parameter dense models and a 3B MoE model. The design changes cache access and execution scheduling, but the supplied abstract ends before numerical efficiency gains or hardware latency measurements.
summary.zh: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer以key和value作为可选择复用的记忆，改变重复Transformer循环之间传递的信息。其U形变体将记忆构建与预测读出分离，并在不改变预测的情况下跳过无用的解码器遍历。作者报告，经过4000亿token预训练后，7亿和15亿参数的稠密模型及30亿参数MoE模型均优于OLMo3。该设计改变了缓存访问与执行调度，但所提供摘要在具体效率收益或硬件时延测量之前截断。

title.en: LoopTitan separates parameter reuse from other looped-MoE gains
title.zh: LoopTitan区分参数复用与循环MoE的其他收益来源

papers.authors: Zichen Tian, Yudong Lu, Xuansheng Wu, et al.

summary.en: LoopTitan finds that parameter revisiting itself contributes almost no gain in its matched-budget MoE experiments once network shape and residual scaling are controlled. A model without revisiting retains the reported improvement, with most attributed to network shape; the residual-scaling benefit disappears under Muon in the authors' analysis. The result argues for evaluating depth-versus-expert allocation before adding recurrent execution to an inference system. It concerns the tested recipes and controls rather than establishing that all forms of parameter reuse are ineffective.
summary.zh: LoopTitan在参数量、FLOPs与KV缓存预算匹配的MoE实验中发现，控制网络形状和残差缩放后，重复访问参数本身几乎不带来收益。无需重复访问的对照模型保留了所报告的提升，其中大部分来自网络形状；作者分析中的残差缩放收益则在采用Muon后消失。这提示推理系统在引入循环执行前，应先评估深度与专家数量的分配。结论针对所测试的训练方案与对照条件，并不等于证明所有参数复用方式都无效。

title.en: Chorus N-gram tables expose a memory-versus-backbone tradeoff
title.zh: Chorus N-gram查找表揭示存储与主干规模的权衡

summary.en: Experiments with 16M–349M-parameter models find that Chorus bigram and trigram hash tables can match a larger plain Transformer's held-out loss, but replace relatively little backbone capacity per added parameter. With tables roughly as large as the backbone, 107M–349M models match plain models 1.16–1.20× their size, while each added parameter replaces at most 0.31 backbone parameters. Chorus trains slower than a same-size plain model and faster than one with the same loss. The memory-compute tradeoff is measured on one historical Polish corpus, one 8,000-token vocabulary and one-fifth of an epoch.
summary.zh: 对1600万至3.49亿参数模型的实验发现，Chorus二元与三元token哈希表可使留出集损失达到更大普通Transformer的水平，但每个新增参数替代的主干容量有限。当查找表规模约等于主干时，1.07亿至3.49亿参数模型可匹配规模为其1.16至1.20倍的普通模型，而每个新增参数最多替代0.31个主干参数。Chorus的训练速度低于同规模普通模型，但高于损失相同的普通模型。这一存储与计算权衡仅在单一历史波兰语语料、8000 token词表及五分之一个训练轮次上评估。

title.en: LLift prepares one checkpoint for multiple SVD compression budgets
title.zh: LLift使单个检查点适配多种SVD压缩预算

papers.authors: Chenyue Fang, Danila Mishin, Babak Falsafi

summary.en: LLift fine-tunes a low-rank approximation at one compression ratio using the original model as a teacher, then merges the updates while preserving weight components excluded from that forward pass. The prepared checkpoint reuses SVD decompositions at different truncation ranks without separately fine-tuning every compressed model. On LLaMA-7B, the authors report accuracy gains at three compression ratios and extensions across model families, sizes and SVD operators. This could simplify deployment across memory budgets, although the abstract gives no quantified accuracy gains or inference-speed measurements.
summary.zh: LLift以原始模型为教师，在单一压缩比例下微调低秩近似，再合并更新，同时保留训练前向传播中未使用的权重分量。处理后的检查点可在不同截断秩下复用SVD分解，无需为每个压缩模型分别微调。作者在LLaMA-7B的3种压缩比例下报告精度改善，并将结果扩展至不同模型家族、规模和SVD压缩算子。这可能简化面向不同内存预算的部署，但摘要未量化精度增益或推理速度。

title.en: Circuits & Communication Systems
title.zh: 电路与通信系统

title.en: Selective transfer learning adapts autoencoder communication front ends
title.zh: 选择性迁移学习适配自编码器通信前端

summary.en: This study adapts an autoencoder-based physical layer to channel mismatch by fine-tuning a small subset of transmitter and receiver layers while freezing the rest. It formulates layer selection as a budget-constrained optimization problem and reports removing a mismatch-induced error floor when moving from AWGN training to Rayleigh fading with front-end impairments. The approach targets the time and energy cost of updating learned communications systems. The supplied abstract is truncated and provides no measured silicon power, adaptation latency or complete BER comparison.
summary.zh: 这项研究通过仅微调发射端与接收端的少数层、冻结其余层，使基于自编码器的物理层适应信道失配。作者将层选择建模为预算约束下的优化问题，并报告在从AWGN训练条件转向带前端非理想因素的瑞利衰落信道时，消除了失配引起的误码率平台。该方法针对学习式通信系统更新时的时间与能耗开销。所提供摘要存在截断，未给出芯片功耗实测、适配时延或完整的误码率对比。
